# Function to rename columns with a suffix
def rename_columns(df, suffix):
    columns = df.columns.tolist()
    new_columns = [f"{col}_{suffix}" for col in columns]
    df.columns = new_columns
    return df

# Rename columns in each dataset
adjusted_savings_df = rename_columns(adjusted_savings_df, 'adjusted_savings')
exports_df = rename_columns(exports_df, 'exports')
gni_df = rename_columns(gni_df, 'gni')
labor_force_df = rename_columns(labor_force_df, 'labor_force')
primary_enrollment_df = rename_columns(primary_enrollment_df, 'primary_enrollment')
